text:
Tara (PM): Starting a short thread to land governance for the new `graded fallback` rollout. This is a per-region + per-tenant feature that will automatically route to a lower-latency quantized variant when regional latency or error budgets are breached. Need: clear ramp cadence, per-tenant exemption UX, session binding rules, and concrete rollback heuristics.

Rohit (Eng): High level OK. We should treat this as three independent knobs: shadowing (observability), sampling (A/B quality checks), and active routing (actual traffic switch). Each has its own gates.

Sam (SRE): Ops constraints: no global flip-flops. Propose throttle: if we trigger rollback in the same region more than twice in a 4h window, auto-offline the flag for that region and page infra lead. Also require that each ramp step hold for a minimum stable window (suggest 6h) before next step.

June (Infra): On session continuity: if a session has KV state or has more than one roundtrip, keep sticky routing to the variant it started on. We'll set routing binding TTL to session TTL + 5s buffer. If variantcompatibility mismatch found, fall back the session to original model and flag tenant for migration.

Asha (CS): Customers care about predictability. Enterprise tenants should be able to opt-in or opt-out via UI/API. Default for enterprise/private deployments is opt-out. We need an audit log entry every time the toggle changes and a preview endpoint so customers can inspect fallback outputs before any switch.

Tara (PM): Proposed ramp cadence (per-region): shadow 24h -> micro 0.5% for 4h -> small 3% for 12h -> controlled 20% for 12h -> wide 80% for 12h -> full. Each step gates on latency & errors.

Rohit (Eng): Quality gates: run A/B sampling in shadow and compute embedding cosine (mean >= 0.92, 5th percentile >= 0.85) and a simple business proxy (e.g., success rate on intent-specific traffic) not to regress >1.5pp. If quality fails, abort and escalate.

Sam (SRE): Metric thresholds to gate on (example): p95 delta <= +15% vs baseline over the step window AND 5xx delta <= +0.2 percentage points. Hard abort if p95 > 900ms or 5xx > 1% in the region. Also watch GPU queue depth and per-host CPU tail.

June (Infra): Feature flag schema example (per-region & per-tenant overrides): flag: graded_fallback_v1; regions: list; default_ramp: [0.5,3,20,80,100]; sticky_sessions: true; shadow_period_hours: 24. Tenants may have override keys: tenant.<id>.fallback_disabled=true.

Asha (CS): For rollout comms: notify platinum customers 7 days prior with an opt-in preview option, gold 3 days prior, silver auto-notify with opt-out. Also provide a per-tenant preview endpoint and an exportable audit of preview comparisons.

Rohit (Eng): Implementation nuance: avoid mid-session variant swaps. We'll route by session id hash -> variant mapping in the routing cache. Cache entries will include variant id and KV cache version tag. If we detect KV version mismatch on candidate variant, keep original variant for that session.

Sam (SRE): Runbook steps: on gate fail, run `rw rollback enact --flag graded_fallback_v1 --region <r> --reason <metric>` which flips routing and triggers incident notify. Capture the last 60min of sampled request/response pairs (PII redacted) for postmortem. If oscillation threshold exceeded, run `rw flag disable --flag graded_fallback_v1 --region <r>`.

June (Infra): We'll also add a migration marker when a tenant's session binds to a fallback variant with incompatible KV schema so product can schedule background migration.

docs-bot: Checklist generated: docs updated, opt-out API present, preview endpoints live, dashboards for p50/p95/p99 + 5xx + cos_sim + cost_delta, on-call assigned for first 72h of each region ramp, postmortem template ready.

Tara (PM): Action items: Rohit to spec sticky-routing + KV version tag by EOD Wed (TICKET ENG-9023). June to add flag schema + routing TTL change (TICKET INF-4102). Sam to author rollback automation and runbook (TICKET SRE-3200). Asha to draft customer comms for platinum cohort (TICKET CS-211). Reconvene Fri 10am PT for sign-off. Thumbs up or comment if blocked. :thumbsup:
